categories.name: slip_wet
categories.title: Slip & Wet Floor
categories.description: Liquid spills, damp or polished floor surfaces, soap residue, or loose mats creating loss of traction on walking paths.
examples: wet or shiny floor
liquid spills or puddles
soap residue near sinks, showers, or tubs
unanchored loose rug or mat
oil or grease splatters on floor

categories.name: trip_clutter
categories.title: Trip & Walkway Clutter
categories.description: Objects, trailing cables, clutter in primary walking paths, or uneven floor transitions that can cause stumbles.
examples: objects left in walkways
loose electrical cables on floor
uneven door threshold or transition strip
scattered toys or shoes
curled rug corners

categories.name: electrical
categories.title: Electrical Hazard
categories.description: Exposed electrical wiring, damaged insulation, overloaded power strips, sockets near moisture, or uncovered wall outlets.
examples: exposed electrical wiring
damaged or frayed cord
overloaded socket strip or adapter
power socket located near water source
uncovered lower wall sockets

categories.name: fire_heat
categories.title: Fire & Heat Hazard
categories.description: Open flames, hot stovetops or cookware, space heaters, hot liquids, combustible materials near heat sources, or gas cylinder issues.
examples: open flame or active burner
hot stove or appliance surface
hot liquid in reach or pan handle protruding
flammable materials near heat source
gas cylinder, regulator, or smell of gas
smoke or burning smell

categories.name: sharp_glass
categories.title: Sharp Objects & Glass
categories.description: Unsheathed knives, broken glass or ceramics, razor blades, sharp metal edges, or uncovered cutting tools.
examples: unsheathed kitchen knives on counter
broken glass or ceramic shards
exposed razor blades or box cutters
sharp protruding metal edges or trim
scissors or shears left open

categories.name: fall_height
categories.title: Fall from Height
categories.description: Unguarded stairs, open balcony or window ledges, ladders, raised platforms, open drains, or steep drops without barriers.
examples: stairs without safety guard or gate
unprotected balcony or low window ledge
unattended standing ladder or stepstool
open floor drain or deep pit
raised unguarded ledge or loft drop

categories.name: unstable_falling
categories.title: Unstable & Falling Objects
categories.description: Tall unanchored furniture, televisions on unstable or narrow stands, heavy items stacked on high shelves, or insecure hanging fixtures.
examples: tall unanchored bookcase or dresser
television placed on narrow or wobbly stand
heavy boxes or planters on high shelves
insecurely hanging wall mirror or frame
climbable furniture with tip-over risk

categories.name: chemical_poison
categories.title: Chemical & Poison Hazard
categories.description: Household cleaning chemicals, unsealed medicines, pesticides, detergents, alcohol, or corrosive fluids accessible within reach.
examples: prescription or OTC medicines on tables
cleaning agents or bleach within reach
garden pesticides or chemical sprays
liquid detergent pods or drain cleaners
accessible bottles of alcohol or fuel

categories.name: choking_small_objects
categories.title: Choking & Small Objects
categories.description: Loose coins, button batteries, small toy parts, beads, small magnetic items, or pebbles that pose choking hazards for young children.
examples: loose coins on low coffee table or floor
button batteries or open battery compartment
small toy parts under 3 cm
beads, buttons, or loose screws
small powerful magnets or marbles

categories.name: water_drowning
categories.title: Water & Drowning Hazard
categories.description: Open buckets or tubs filled with water, uncovered storage tanks, filled bathtubs, paddling pools, or open drainage sumps.
examples: open bucket or tub filled with water
filled bathtub left unattended
uncovered water storage tank or sump
unfenced paddling pool or garden pond
large water trough accessible to infants

categories.name: strangulation_entrapment
categories.title: Strangulation & Entrapment
categories.description: Dangling blind or curtain cords, loose ropes, plastic bags, cords near cribs, or entrapment gaps in railings and furniture.
examples: looped window blind or curtain cords
thin plastic bags within infant reach
wide gaps between crib slats or bed railings
loose ropes or cords near sleeping area
entrapment spaces between wall and furniture

categories.name: structural_damage
categories.title: Structural Damage
categories.description: Cracks in walls or ceilings, spalling or hanging plaster, severe damp or mould patches, broken railing, or loose architectural elements.
examples: deep masonry cracks in wall or beam
hanging or crumbling ceiling plaster
severe damp or visible black mould patches
loose, wobbly, or broken stair banister
loose floor tiles or rotting floorboards

categories.name: poor_visibility
categories.title: Poor Visibility & Glare
categories.description: Inadequate illumination on stairs or hallways, blinding glare, shadows obscuring hazards, or obstructed lines of sight.
examples: unlit or dark stairs and corridors
harsh unshielded glare obscuring steps
burned-out light fixtures in high-traffic path
heavy shadows hiding floor obstacles or drop-offs
blocked sight lines at blind corners

categories.name: outdoor_traffic_terrain
categories.title: Outdoor Traffic & Terrain
categories.description: Vehicle traffic proximity, open gates near roadway, potholes, broken sidewalks, steep slippery slopes, or exposed utility wiring outdoors.
examples: open perimeter gate leading directly to roadway
deep potholes or broken pavement in walking path
steep uneven slope or unpaved embankment
low-hanging or exposed utility wiring outdoors
unfenced vehicle maneuvering or parking zone

categories.name: other_observable
categories.title: Other Observable Hazard
categories.description: Physical hazards directly visible in the scene that do not clearly fit into categories H01 through H14; classified with uncertain status.
examples: unusual physical obstruction or barrier
unidentified container with hazardous markings
atypical observable mechanical hazard
unclassified environmental safety concern
